speaker: Kyle
text: These ruins... they used to be filled with laughter and the scent of fresh bread. Now, only ash remains.

speaker: Kyle
text: Father... your words still echo in my mind. 'Find Blade Edge, destroy them all.' I won't let your sacrifice be in vain.

speaker: Kyle
text: No tracks. No signs of life. But I can feel them. Watching. Waiting.

speaker: Kyle
text: Every broken stone here is a reminder... This place was my home.
